read.passage: Last week, our school radio team interviewed Mr Salem, the head teacher, about the new reading corner. He told us that the corner would open after the mid-year holiday. He said that students had chosen most of the books themselves. When we asked him whether students could borrow the books, he said they could take two books home every week. However, he asked everyone to look after the books and return them on time. The team also spoke to Huda in Year 8. She said the reading corner was a great idea because the library was often too crowded. She admitted that she didn't read much before, but she wanted to take up reading this year.

qs.q: When will the reading corner open?
options: at the end of the year

qs.q: How many books can students take home each week?
Why does Huda like the idea?
options: She has read all the books.
